choose.installer_text: After installing, you'll find it in the Start menu.
choose.program_text: You can also run it without installing.
choose.linux_package: This package was made for another Linux system, but it can be installed here too, and you'll find it in the Start menu. If it's also available in Discover, that is usually the better choice.
choose.flathub_available: {name} is also available in Discover. That version fits the system better and updates itself, so we recommend it.
pick.question_manage: What should be in the Start menu?
pick.question_install: What should go into the Start menu?
pick.question_unsure: We couldn't tell for sure which file starts the program. Tick what should go into the Start menu, or choose another file.
status.finish_in_installer: Finish the installation in the installer window. When you're done, we'll continue here.
status.first_setup: Getting ready for the first start…
error.not_found: We can't find the program. It may have been deleted; please install it again.
error.runtime_missing: A component needed to run programs is missing. Update the system in Sloth Center.
error.not_started: {name} didn't start. This program may not work on this system, or the file may be damaged.
error.nothing_installed: We couldn't find an installed program. The installation may have been interrupted; please try again.
error.package_failed: Installing {name} didn't work. Check your internet connection and try again.
info.already_running: {name} is already running. You'll find its window in the taskbar.
package.installed: {name} is installed. You'll find it in the Start menu.
package.installed_no_app: {name} is installed, but it has no program that can be started from the Start menu.
package.mac: {name} was made for Mac and doesn't run on this computer. There may be a Linux version: look for it in Discover.
package.mac_script: This is a Mac script file. For safety reasons, we don't run it.
anticheat.blocked: {game} uses the {system} anti-cheat, which doesn't allow the game to run on Linux. It's not your computer's fault, and we can't get around it. Unfortunately this game can't be played here.
anticheat.maybe: {game} uses the {system} anti-cheat. It only works on Linux if the game's makers have allowed it. If the game won't start or kicks you out, this is probably why. It's worth checking whether the game has a Steam version.
desktop.name: Windows programs
desktop.comment: Install and run Windows programs and games
